persona: Operations analyst who builds Power Automate Desktop bots
resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Mumbai | sneha.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Documented each process as a step-by-step flowchart with the finance team before building it.
- Added retry and error handling steps so failed runs email the support mailbox.
- Wrote SQL queries to check posted entries against the ledger tables.

Operations Executive, Arabian Sea Shared Services, Mumbai (2021 - 2023)
- Maintained Excel trackers with VLOOKUP and pivot tables for vendor payments.

EDUCATION
BCom, University of Mumbai, 2021

SKILLS
Power Automate Desktop, Python, SQL, Excel, UiPath (learning)
